question: When arranging the selected deities, should the back triad be abandoned so that one remains in front, or may another arrangement obtain?
inference: The verse prescribes leaving three rear items and placing one forward, with an optional alternative.
uncertainties: exact referent of triad not explicit in this verse
whether bhavet is prescriptive or permissive
plain_english: Leaving the back triad, one [is placed] in front, or it may be [otherwise].
